name: Astra Sight Glimpses 1, then draws a card
notes: Astra Sight is an ASTRA (advanced element) ACTION card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real ASTRA champion (Arisanna, Astral Zenith), same as dwarf-stars-glow-damage/cosmic-bolt-damage/cometfall-sweep-damage, to unlock element access. Its reserve cost is 0, so no reserve payment is needed; a PASS declines the initial fast-response opportunity window, then an MZREARRANGE decision resolves the Glimpse 1 (keeping the revealed card on top), after which the separate draw effect resolves automatically. Only the base Glimpse 1 + draw effect is covered; the Starcalling (0) alternate-timing clause is out of scope.
